releases.summary: Introduces a verifiable public release record and update history for the TinyRustLM dogfood site.

changes.summary: Added a visible site version, release date, last-published status, and human-readable update history.
Added strict machine-readable current-release and release-history records under .well-known.
Bound web publication to clean source identity, exact release metadata, secret scanning, and HTTPS readback evidence.

releases.summary: Makes the TinyRustLM release record fully readable and reachable across app viewports.

changes.summary: Removed desktop footer truncation from the version, release date, and last-published facts.
Added a compact release summary and updates link for narrow-desktop and mobile layouts.
Aligned the initial no-model status with the authoritative browser model-admission state.
Expanded browser release verification to require visible, in-viewport, unclipped release facts on every published app and history view.

releases.summary: Completes the release-readability deployment and hardens publication recovery.

changes.summary: Completed the app and update-history surfaces left inconsistent by the interrupted 0.1.1 publication attempt.
Made the current-release JSON the final publication commit marker after all site content and release history.
Reconciled ambiguous FTPS rename responses through bounded read-only observations before rollback.
Preserved the publicly observed 0.1.1 identity and advanced recovery as a distinct version.
